subject: general
question: In July 2024, Charaideo Maidam was included in the UNESCO World Heritage Site list in the cultural category. In which of the following states is it located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Charaideo Maidam** is located in the state of **Assam**, India.
 
• It is historically significant as it is the **burial site of the Ahom kings** and queens.
 
• The site includes several **maidams** (mound burial sites), which are similar to pyramids and reflect the rich cultural heritage of the Ahom dynasty.
 
• The **Ahom dynasty** ruled Assam for nearly 600 years, and Charaideo was the first capital established by the founder of the dynasty, **Chaolung Sukapha**.
 
• The inclusion of Charaideo Maidam in the **UNESCO World Heritage Site list** acknowledges its cultural and historical importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bihar**__

 __
 
• Bihar is known for its rich cultural heritage and historical sites such as **Mahabodhi Temple** in Bodh Gaya, where Buddha attained enlightenment.
 
 
 
• **Odisha**__
 __
 
• Odisha is famous for the **Konark Sun Temple** and the annual **Jagannath Rath Yatra** in Puri.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal**__
 
 
• West Bengal is known for its significant landmarks such as the **Victoria Memorial** and the **Howrah Bridge**.
